full_sentence: Whoever finishes the project first will receive a small prize.
acceptable_variants: will be given a small prize.

options.why_wrong: After the modal 'will', the verb must be in the base form 'receive', not 'receives'.
'Is' cannot precede the base verb 'receive' in this structure; the modal 'will' is needed.

options.text: receiving a small prize, because it was funny.
options.why_wrong: The phrase 'because it was funny' adds an unrelated reason and does not complete the predicate of the nominal clause.

grammar_focus: Free relative (nominal) clauses introduced by 'whoever', functioning as the subject of the sentence
explanation: The nominal clause 'Whoever finishes the project first' is the subject, so the main verb must be a future form with a modal and a base verb. The completion must agree with this future time reference.
translation: Той, хто першим закінчить проєкт, отримає невеликий приз.
